covered_cases: origin HTTP 502 remains upstream_5xx while proxy evidence maps gateway 502 to proxy_unavailable 503
DNS, TLS, timeout, refused proxy and reset proxy failures keep distinct content-free classes
auto protocol fallback occurs only on 404, 405, 415 or 501 before output and terminal evidence
transport replay is limited to one pre-output attempt and is forbidden after tool activity
external HTTP retry is limited to 504 or short generic 429 before output
free-route, explicit quota, capacity and Retry-After values above five seconds are not replayed
public messages never include arbitrary upstream detail
side_effects: none; callers own delay, I/O and retry execution
